# Introducing the First Top Twelve

Report 001 | Published 2019-11-10 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2019-11-10/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/001.json)

Defensive macro posture and twelve value selections.

The broad framework is explicitly uncertain, but cheap multiples and yields do not automatically establish adequate risk compensation. New disclosed return sensitivities show strong Southern Copper and eventual Booking results, weaker Scotiabank and TotalEnergies opportunity costs, and near-but-below-target Enbridge compounding. Invesco's dividend reduction and Russian investor-access disruption remain important counterexamples. Unspecified horizons and corporate actions limit precise grading; repeated risk language is not multiple independent recession forecasts.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

## Claims

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Next test:** Rebuild the country-indicator panel with contemporaneous 2015-16 and 2019 releases.

- [Fourth quarter and year 2019 GDP, advance estimate](https://www.bea.gov/news/2020/gross-domestic-product-fourth-quarter-and-year-2019-advance-estimate) | BEA | 2020-01-30 | Verified in the audit

Q4 real GDP grew 2.1% annualized, unchanged from Q3; imports decreased but exports increased. Consumption and business investment slowed; 2019 growth was 2.3% versus 2.9% in 2018.

Quarterly dividend fell from $0.31 for 2019 Q4 to $0.155 for 2020 Q1 and remained $0.155 through 2020.

The article explicitly acknowledges sanctions. Subsequent Sberbank blocking and ADR restrictions expose a severe accessibility risk that low multiples do not hedge. Investor recovery varies; no zero-recovery assumption is justified.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Next test:** Audit actual instrument, nationality, custody, conversion eligibility and recoverable distributions.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [U.S. Treasury escalates sanctions on Russia](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0705) | US Treasury | 2022-04-06 | Verified in the audit

Treasury imposed full blocking sanctions on Sberbank. The accompanying executive order prohibited new investment in Russia by US persons.

- [On depositary receipt facilities of PJSC LUKOIL](https://www.lukoil.com/PressCenter/Pressreleases/Pressrelease/on-depositary-receipt-facilities-of-pjsc-lukoil) | Lukoil | 2022-05-05 | Verified in the audit

Russian law prohibited offshore depositary-receipt circulation. Lukoil announced ADR program termination effective December 30, 2022 and London listing cancellation June 6, with conversion arrangements for eligible holders.
